thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: GPU pool SCL-1 reporting 100% utilization, autoscaler stalled. Queue growth observed on inference-queues/scl. Alert fired: gpu_pool_saturation > 5m.

maya: I'm on it. Paging on-call. Anyone in SCL region?

dario: I'm awake, looking. Confirming autoscaler didn't spawn new nodes — got quota errors from GCP.

ops_lead: FYI customers in LATAM might see increased latency / request drops for image-classify and embed routes. Kumar is pulling impacted request ids for comms.

kumar: started triage — pulling logs and error codes from gateway and autoscaler.

alex_sre: seeing failed GCE quota allocate responses: 403 Quota exceeded. Error snippet: 
```
status: FAILED
message: "QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Insufficient GPUs in project region southamerica-east1"
code: 403
```

maya: ok, so autoscaler tried to create instances but hit regional GPU quota. What's current queue length?

infra-bot: Current queue: inference-queue-scl = 12.3k pending requests, average wait 14s, p50 latency spiking. Node pool scl-gpu-pool = 0 available GPUs, 98% allocation. Autoscaler attempted 4 scale events in last 6m.

dario: Can we route lower-priority traffic to a fallback region? We have capacity in us-central1.

ops_lead: Start routing non-enterprise traffic to us-central1 (fallback-profile-low) NOW. Keep enterprise routes pinned to local region — customers with strict region requirements might need manual comms.

maya: @dario can you flip the routing policy? I'll update SLA comms and mark incident.

dario: flipping route rules in traffic-router: 
```
curl -X POST https://router.redwood.internal/api/v1/route/modify -d '{"match":"service:embed","priority":"low","fallback":"us-central1"}'
```
Response: 200 OK. Starting gradual shift, 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 3m to avoid thundering herd.

kumar: support queue already seeing 5 customer tickets about slow responses. Tagging those as impact: production latency. Preparing status note to affected customers.

sara_support: drafting message: "We're investigating elevated latencies in South America due to capacity constraints. We are routing some traffic to alternate regions; minimal disruption expected. We'll update in 30m." Want to include ETA?

ops_lead: Put ETA 1 hour for mitigation, we'll update as we know more.

alex_sre: Meanwhile, autoscaler logs show repeated terraform/GCP quota API 429/403: 
```
ERROR: quota allocation failed: region southamerica-east1 gpus: request 8 -> granted 0 (project hard limit)
```
We should request quota bump but that's not immediate.

maya: Actions summary so far: 1) route low-priority to us-central1, 2) throttle batch/long-running inference jobs, 3) failover for some workloads to dedicated pools if possible. Anyone owning 3?

dario: I'll throttle batch jobs via rate-limiter: set batch.max_concurrency=2 for queue scl and lower priority services. Pushing config now.

infra-bot: Rate-limiter update applied. Observed drop in new queue entrants for batch by ~40%.

kumar: On comms — customers affected: client-argent, datawise, and several app partners. Sending initial note to SLAs list and account reps now.

maya: Can we spin up smaller quantized instances? Any cheaper GPU shapes available not counted against same quota?

alex_sre: GCP quotas are per GPU type family and project. There is a separate quota for A100 and T4 families. SCL project is out for T4 as well. We can attempt to boot preemptible T4s in us-central1 but cross-region routing already handles that.

dario: Another mitigation: promote some traffic to Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) for customers with contracts. @ops_lead can you authorize dev teams to move eligible customers?

ops_lead: Authorizing now. Communicate to sales/se that we can bring 2-3 priority tenants onto dedicated pools in us-central1; they must consent to cross-region traffic.

maya: Any ETA on GCP support quota increase? Who's on the ticket?

alex_sre: I opened ticket INC-GCP-78921 with support — ref: project:scl-prod — requested emergency quota bump for 32 T4 GPUs. They acknowledged, estimated 3-6h. Not fast enough.

kumar: Noted. For immediate relief, we should implement graceful degradation: reduce model sizes for low-priority requests (compress responses, shorter max tokens).

dario: Implemented a throttling rule: for requests with plan=free or usage_tier=low, override model.max_tokens=256 -> 64 and model_variant=small. Pushed to edge config.

infra-bot: Edge config update success. Observed drop in per-request token consumption by 55% for affected traffic.

sara_support: Customer comms sent to affected list. One enterprise customer replied — "Please confirm no PII moved out of region." Responded: enterprise traffic still pinned to scl and not routed.

maya: Good. Next: do we want to evict non-critical background jobs (e.g., nightly vector index rebuilds) from SCL?

dario: Yes, cancelling rebuilds and batch retraining for the next 6 hours. I pushed job cancellations to airflow.

infra-bot: Airflow cancellations confirmed: 12 DAG runs aborted.

kumar: Status update for execs: "Autoscaler stalled due to regional GPU quota exhaustion. Traffic mitigation in progress via cross-region routing and throttling. Request to GCP raised; ETA unknown. Customer impact limited to increased latency for non-enterprise routes. Dedicated failovers enabled for priority tenants." Send?

ops_lead: Send now. Also notify finance about potential overage if we spin on-demand in alternate cloud.

maya: Monitoring: queue length dropped to 4.1k pending after routing and throttles. p50 latency back to 220ms from 900ms peak. CPU on gateway stable.

alex_sre: Observed a secondary issue: some pods in scl are OOM'ing when model_variant was downshifted. Need to bump pod memory for small-variant. I'm patching deployment.

dario: Patch applied: model-small memory 6Gi -> 8Gi. Pods are recycling.

infra-bot: Pod restarts dropping, memory pressure normalizing.

maya: OK — situational update in timeline channel. Keep this thread alive for next 2 hours. Who will be primary for follow-ups?

dario: I'll own mitigation until autoscaler healthy or quota bump confirmed.

kumar: I'll maintain customer comms and update tickets.

ops_lead: I'll coordinate with sales/CS for any affected enterprise comms and billing consideration.

maya: Thanks team. Post-incident follow-up items: 1) runbook gap: add explicit fallback routing automation when regional quota error patterns observed, 2) evaluate multi-project quotas for critical pools to avoid single-project hard limits, 3) add auto-degrade policy when queue > 5k for >10m.

alex_sre: Logging action item: capture exact autoscaler API responses and tag with request ids so we can alert earlier.

infra-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> partial. Thresholds normalized but quota remains exhausted. Next update in 30m or sooner if change.

maya: Closing initial pager but keeping the incident channel open. If anything spikes again, ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
